# Service Design

## Procedure
1. Establish the service boundary, decision, authorized channels, stakeholders, and evidence. Use approved product storage; obtain VOC research rather than inventing journeys.
2. Map before/during/after interactions, channels, user-visible evidence, frontline activities, backstage processes, systems/data flows, handoffs, recovery paths, support, and accountable owners. Mark each step as observed, source-linked, or hypothesized; include a source/date and failure or wait state for material handoffs. Distinguish assumptions from operational commitments.
3. Identify waiting, repeated effort, broken handoffs, exclusion, and recovery gaps. Evaluate whether a local UI improvement transfers cost or harm to another touchpoint.
4. Route technical feasibility to Squad through Factory or the active authorized coordinator; request missing user/employee evidence from VOC through an explicitly permitted route. This skill does not grant ProductOwner direct Squad delegation. Propose a bounded service improvement with user-visible acceptance criteria, operational owner, and failure/recovery evidence.
5. ProductOwner dispositions and prioritizes within authority; Kanban records only authorized work. Organizational, staffing, or external-service changes require their appropriate owner decisions.
6. Review the integrated journey after authorized delivery, including exception handling, handoff success/failure, wait time or rework measures where available, and support burden, not only the app screen. Compare against the documented baseline and identify unobserved backstage steps rather than declaring service improvement from a UI change alone.

## Completion Checks
The service map has evidence and ownership; hypotheses, dependencies, and affected parties are explicit. This skill creates design decisions, not authority to reorganize teams or contact customers.

Original procedure informed by item 17 of [UX Playbook's UX skills article](https://uxplaybook.org/articles/top-skills-every-ux-designer-needs), accessed October 11, 2026.
